           │ SHARED PROJECTS                                                                      │
           │ No active project on this server to share.                                           │
           │ A shared project shows, read-only, in the sidebar of every paired server: what waits │
           │ for you, the inbox, threads, tasks on deck and its sessions' states; never its       │
           │ files. Space toggles it, as Shared with paired servers in the project's own Settings │
           │ tab; sharing asks first.                                                             │
           │                                                                                      │
           │ PAIRED SERVERS                                                                       │
           │ This server isn't paired with another. Press n to pair: it shows a code to pass on,  │
           │ and j on the other server takes it (or tm peer pair and tm peer join in a terminal); │
           │ both of you then compare six digits.                                                 │
           │ No relay yet? On a Linux server with a domain: sudo tm relay install --domain NAME;  │
           │ without one, on an address both servers reach: sudo tm relay install --ip (see the   │
           │ README).                                                                             │
           │                                                                                      │
           │ Paired servers see the projects you share with them, read-only, in their sidebar;    │
           │                                                                                      │
           │ space toggle · ← → change · n pair · j join · e relay · u update relay · x remove    │
           │ esc close                                                                            │
